lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observation of approximately five vertical columns of high-intensity circular blobs on the mid-lateral flank, with each column containing 3 to 4 distinct spots in a regular grid-like spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular high-intensity blobs, forming a visible coordinate-like mesh across the visible lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular white notch or lesion is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, indicating potential physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two remoras (Echeneidae) visible on the ventral surface and swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin.
